title: Amphiphilic self-assembled dye-sensitized graphene quantum dots for efficient hydrogen evolution in seawater
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2175-2183
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00148J, Paper
Hyunho Park, Soo Young Park
This study introduces a metal-free photocatalyst, GQD-HA with TPATCS, enhancing hydrogen production in seawater. The robust structure shows improved hydrogen rates and photostability, promising for sustainable energy.
